h1: Hotel Once Bangkok — Rooftop River Views and a Private Jacuzzi, Ranked #4 in Bangkok
intro: On the historic Charoenkrung Road at Soi 72/2 in Bang Kho Laem district, a nine-storey boutique hotel has earned a remarkable position — Hotel Once Bangkok is ranked #4 out of 1,384 Bangkok hotels on TripAdvisor, based on 1,112 genuine guest reviews. The combination of a rooftop bar overlooking the Chao Phraya River, Executive Jacuzzi rooms with freestanding baths, and a genuinely attentive team makes it a rare find at this price point. 43 rooms, outdoor pool, 5-minute walk to Asiatique The Riverfront. From approximately THB 1,800/night · Score 9.2/10 (Service 9.4 · Cleanliness 9.4).

Outdoor pool at Hotel Once Bangkok — a calm retreat for relaxing afternoons

body.html: Hotel Once Bangkok opened in 2014 on Charoenkrung — Bangkok's first paved road and one of the city's most character-filled streets. The neighbourhood offers a compelling mix of century-old shophouses, independent coffee spots, contemporary art galleries and the busy Asiatique The Riverfront just a five-minute stroll away. The hotel's nine-storey building was conceived in a Modern Classic style: deep green walls, dark timber furnishings with colonial-era references, and a loft sensibility that feels simultaneously nostalgic and contemporary.

Across its 43 rooms, guests choose between Deluxe King, Deluxe Twin, Executive Jacuzzi Room and Executive Twin Studio configurations. The Executive Jacuzzi Room generates the most enthusiasm in reviews — a private jacuzzi or freestanding bathtub becomes the centrepiece of a room roughly 40 sq m, paired with the hotel's dark-wood aesthetic for a genuinely indulgent feel. One important note from real reviews: some Standard-category rooms have obscured windows that limit natural light, creating a slightly enclosed atmosphere. Always specify your room preference — or contact the hotel directly — when booking.
"Very clean and really nice-smelling. Staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. The rooftop view is stunning — great value for the price."

The hotel's most talked-about feature across 1,112 reviews is the Top Knot Rooftop Bar and Restaurant on the ninth floor. At sunset and into the night, views over the Chao Phraya River and Bangkok's skyline are genuinely beautiful — multiple reviewers describe the evening there as the best moment of their entire Bangkok trip. The café and bar offerings extend to Ron Ron Slow Bar for unhurried morning coffee and Bacon Salmon Pizza Caravan for casual dining, giving the property a full day's rhythm without ever needing to step out.

In terms of connectivity, Asiatique The Riverfront is a five-minute walk. From Asiatique, the Chao Phraya Express Boat reaches BTS Saphan Taksin (Taksin Bridge) quickly, connecting to the BTS Silom Line. Upriver, the same boats run to Wat Arun, Wat Pho, Tha Chang pier and the Grand Palace — making day trips to Bangkok's temple belt easy and inexpensive. Charoenkrung itself is a strong slow-travel destination: the street rewards those who walk it unhurriedly, stopping at hidden cafés, murals and local food vendors that have traded here for decades.

Honest notes from the review record: the outdoor pool is modestly sized and, as several guests point out, is not the hotel's headline attraction compared to the rooftop and room quality. Some rooms have noise from air-conditioning units or external machinery, particularly on lower floors. Water pressure in certain bathrooms has also been noted as modest. And since there is no free hotel shuttle, anyone needing to reach Sukhumvit or Silom CBD directly should budget for a Grab ride (approximately THB 60–100 to BTS Saphan Taksin) or plan around the river-boat timetable.

What genuinely distinguishes Hotel Once Bangkok is its service record. A Service score of 9.4/10 across over a thousand reviews reflects consistent, meaningful hospitality — complimentary room upgrades, warm welcome drinks, and staff who answer travel questions knowledgeably. For a stay priced from approximately THB 1,800/night for Deluxe rooms and THB 3,500–4,500 for Executive Jacuzzi rooms, this is a boutique experience that punches above the standard for its category along the riverside.

highlights.title: Top Knot Rooftop Bar
highlights.text: 9th-floor rooftop with sweeping Chao Phraya River views at night, Thai cuisine and signature cocktails — repeatedly cited by guests as the highlight of their Bangkok stay.

highlights.title: Executive Jacuzzi Rooms
highlights.text: Private jacuzzi or freestanding bathtub in a 40 sq m room with deep-green walls and dark timber, giving the feel of a boutique spa hotel at a mid-range price.

highlights.text: Prime Charoenkrung location: stroll to Asiatique, take the river ferry to Wat Arun or Wat Pho, or connect to BTS Saphan Taksin — Bangkok's main temple belt is fully accessible.

honestSummary: Hotel Once Bangkok delivers a boutique experience well above its price bracket — a rooftop bar with real river views, Executive Jacuzzi rooms that feel genuinely indulgent, and service that earns one of the highest consistency scores in Bangkok. The honest caveats: some rooms have limited natural light, the pool is compact, and reaching BTS directly requires a Grab ride or river ferry. Plan your logistics and you will find this one of the most rewarding mid-range stays on the Bangkok riverside.
honestChecks: If natural light in your room matters — specify an Executive-category room or a higher floor when booking. Some Standard rooms have opaque-style windows that limit daylight. Contact the hotel directly to confirm before check-in.

If you need BTS access every day — there is no free shuttle. Budget THB 60–100 per Grab ride to BTS Saphan Taksin, or use the Chao Phraya Express Boat from near Asiatique. Factor this into your daily transport budget.

If an Executive Jacuzzi Room is the reason for your stay — these rooms book out weeks in advance during high season (November–February) and on holiday weekends. Book at least two to three weeks ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate.

tips.title: Upgrade to the Executive Jacuzzi
tips.body: The difference between Deluxe and Executive is significant. The jacuzzi or freestanding tub makes for a far more memorable stay — more relaxing than booking an outside spa, especially after a long day exploring Asiatique and the river temples.

tips.title: Top Knot at Sunset — 5:30–7:00 PM
tips.body: The rooftop bar is most spectacular between 17:30 and 19:00 when the light turns golden over the Chao Phraya. Arrive early to claim a good spot, order a signature cocktail, and let the evening unfold slowly.

tips.title: Use the Chao Phraya Express Boat
tips.body: The pier near Asiatique connects to Wat Arun, Wat Pho, Tha Chang and BTS Saphan Taksin. It is cheaper and often faster than Grab during peak hours — and considerably more scenic.

tips.title: Explore Charoenkrung on Foot
tips.body: The street in front of the hotel is one of Bangkok's most rewarding slow-walk routes — independent coffee shops, street food vendors who have traded here for decades, and galleries tucked into repurposed shophouses. Save a morning for it.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Hotel Once Bangkok

faq.q: Where is Hotel Once Bangkok and how do I get there?
faq.a: The hotel is at 2074/99 Soi Charoenkrung 72/2, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, a five-minute walk from Asiatique The Riverfront. From Asiatique, take the Chao Phraya Express Boat to BTS Saphan Taksin and connect to the BTS Silom Line. A Grab from the BTS station costs approximately THB 60–100.

faq.q: What are the room prices at Hotel Once Bangkok?
faq.a: Rates start from approximately THB 1,800/night for a Deluxe King Room. Executive Jacuzzi Rooms run THB 3,500–4,500/night depending on the season. Prices rise during high season (November–February) and public holidays. Compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: Do all rooms at Hotel Once Bangkok have a jacuzzi?
faq.a: No — only the Executive Jacuzzi Room category includes a private jacuzzi or freestanding bathtub. Standard Deluxe rooms have conventional bathrooms. If a jacuzzi is the purpose of your stay, book that category specifically.

faq.q: What ranking does Hotel Once Bangkok hold, and how many reviews does it have?
faq.a: As of early 2026, Hotel Once Bangkok ranks #4 out of 1,384 hotels in Bangkok on TripAdvisor, with 1,112 reviews. Trip.com score is 9.2/10 with Service rated 9.4 and Cleanliness 9.4.

faq.q: Is Hotel Once Bangkok good for couples or a romantic stay?
faq.a: Yes — the boutique ambience, Executive Jacuzzi rooms, and rooftop bar make it one of the more atmospheric mid-range romantic choices on the Bangkok riverside. The slow-walk neighbourhood of Charoenkrung, with its independent cafés and galleries, adds to the appeal.
